description: IncidentNews is run by the Emergency Response Division of NOAA's Office of Response and Restoration (OR&R). The site, read on 2026-09-26, gives news, photos and information on selected oil spills and other incidents in US waters where OR&R gave scientific support to the response, covering thousands of incidents over 30 years of OR&R response; some records from 1957 to 1984 come from third-party databases. Yearly counts on the home page run from 1985 to 117 incidents so far in 2026, and recent entries include a crude oil spill with in-situ burn in Louisiana and wellhead sheens in the Gulf. The raw data page offers incidents.csv, about two megabytes, one row per incident with id, open date, name, location, latitude and longitude, primary threat (oil, chemical or other) and further fields, plus browse, map, search and Atom and RSS feeds. The contents are in the public domain and free. Caveats: only incidents with OR&R support are listed and coordinates may be approximate. Simulation uses are spill hazard exposure for coastal energy assets and emergency response planning. Related records: data-itopf-oil-tanker-spill-statistics gives global tanker spill trends.
